claims: The Los Angeles Dodgers and Uniqlo announced a partnership for the 2026 season.
The partnership renames the playing field at Dodger Stadium to Uniqlo Field at Dodger Stadium.
The partnership is a five-year deal.
The five-year deal marks the first time Dodger Stadium's field has had a sponsor name.
The official name is Uniqlo Field at Dodger Stadium.
The new branding was unveiled on March 25, 2026.
The new branding includes a prominent sign above the center-field batter's eye.
The unveiling was ahead of the season opener.
Uniqlo is a Japanese apparel brand.
The five-year deal is reportedly valued at over $125 million.
The deal secures a sponsor name for the field itself.
The deal keeps the overall historic stadium name intact
